links.outcome: SOAP note quality including hallucination penalty across five open-weight LLMs
links.effect: DeepSeek V3.2 achieved the best consolidated quality (0.87) and the highest clinical grounding (0.96); assessment and plan sections account for most errors.
links.quote: DeepSeek V3.2 achieved the best consolidated quality (0.87) and the highest clinical grounding (0.96).

unlisted_practices: Provider-agnostic microservice architecture for asynchronous clinical audio processing
Safety-weighted Clinical Documentation Quality Index penalizing hallucinations
On-premises open-weight models for data sovereignty under Brazilian data-protection law

screen.reason: The study introduces a technical architecture and benchmarks five open-weight LLMs on synthetic teleconsultation transcripts for SOAP note generation in Brazilian Portuguese, proposing an evaluation metric, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
